title: Cross by boat to the Maó Lazaretto
location: Illa del Llatzeret, Maó harbour · boat from Cales Fonts
description: A walled hospital island inside Maó harbour, built in the 18th and 19th centuries to quarantine ships from across the Mediterranean: some 400,000 people passed through it. The guided visit lasts about two and a half hours and leaves by boat from the quay at Cales Fonts, in Es Castell, fifteen minutes beforehand. Book through the Consell's website; everyone needs a ticket, children included.
imageAlt: The inner garden of the Maó Lazaretto, a palm tree and the stone walls
